subject.title: docs: publish release notes for v2026.7.1

question: Does the reconciled PR preserve current main’s release-only v2026.7.1 boundary while providing the approved canonical public release notes?
rationale: The changelog is release-owned, and current main contains release-boundary edits newer than this branch’s base; determining the canonical public record requires release-owner intent rather than automated conflict assumptions.

options.title: Reconcile and land
options.body: Rebase or resolve the changelog against current main, re-run attribution and docs checks, and merge the detailed release page once the release-only boundary is confirmed.

options.title: Keep compact changelog
options.body: Land only the dedicated release page and navigation while retaining current main’s compact or separately maintained changelog section.

options.title: Pause publication
options.body: Hold the PR if the 2,109-unit attribution set or release boundary cannot be verified against the published tag.

recommendation.title: Reconcile and land
recommendation.body: Rebase or resolve the changelog against current main, re-run attribution and docs checks, and merge the detailed release page once the release-only boundary is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the latest current-main v2026.7.1 changelog restoration and release-only boundary commits.
